answer: Bind each agent identity to a rolling vine of signed work receipts: every epoch the agent must countersign a random peer's transaction, and that peer must countersign back. Sybil clusters form a closed knoll in the graph, so we score identities by how much of their trust flows from distant, independently aged nodes rather than siblings. A farm of fresh keys is an island in an ocean of established peers and earns nothing until outsiders vouch for it over many epochs.
